parameters.content:
## [WF-01v3] RSS Score & Curate

PHASE 1 (COLLECT): Fetch RSS feeds by batch, attach metadata, filter old articles
PHASE 2 (CLASSIFY): Dedup against DB, batch classify with GPT-5.4-nano, parse results
PHASE 3 (CURATE): Cluster by tags, cross-domain detection, score + rank, bulk save to Supabase
PHASE 4 (PRESENT): Morning summary + individual cards on Telegram with approve/skip buttons

CONFIG: All thresholds in the Config node
BATCH_NUMBER: -1 = all feeds, 0-23 = hourly batch

## Planned Improvements

- Schedule Trigger (replace Manual Trigger for production)
- Telegram Topics (thread-based categories)
- Learning loop (Brett's approvals feed back into scoring)
- Full article extraction via Jina for top articles
- 5-dimension scoring with GPT-5.4-mini on extracted content
- Error Handler integration (WF-00)
- Adaptive batch sizing based on feed volume
